differences: The paper removes reaches whose initial direction is more than 45 deg from the midline (Experiments 1 and 2) or that were not completed in time; the authors' script removes |initial direction| > 75 deg, latency outside 150 to 600 ms and peak speed below 0.3 m/s. The deposit already has those reaches blanked, so the excluded rows carry no values. The median share of reaches blanked per participant is 4.8 % in Experiment 1 (paper: 6.8 %) and 3.6 % in Experiment 2 (paper: 11.4 %); the Experiment 2 deposit has fewer blanked reaches than the paper's criteria remove, so the paper's removals were probably applied partly in the authors' analysis, not in the deposit.

Experiment 3: the paper reports that a median of 10.5 % of reaches were removed per participant (initial direction beyond 75 deg, movement not completed in 2500 ms, or incomplete trial). The excluded reaches are not in the deposit, which keeps no row for them, so this cannot be reproduced from the rows; the share of blank positions inside the filled part of the arrays is 10.9 % (median over participants), which is not the same quantity. The paper's median of 6.8 % and 11.4 % in Experiments 1 and 2 are discussed above.
